issues: The subjects were six grey skeleton cards with nothing readable, so standing them up revealed nothing
Flat grey background with a black sidebar wedge poking in on the left: it looked like an unfinished wireframe
The camera angle barely changed, so lying and standing states looked alike and the rise had little drama
Six identical cards at even spacing and even stagger: no depth layers and no closing accent
changes: Paper look (warm paper, ink, vermilion): an open annual-report pop-up book with a gutter shadow, page-edge thickness and paper fibre
Seven shot-designed data pieces: three tall back cards (revenue chart $4.82M, active teams, NPS ring), three short front cards (uptime, churn, releases) and a front ink banner 'Year in review.'
Typography: 72-150px heavy numerals with mono labels; vermilion only on the revenue line, the title period and the year
Rhythm: back row 6f apart, front row 5f apart (accelerating), banner last at 52f as the closing accent; springs at damping 11 overshoot to ~95 degrees and settle
The camera cranes down from 55 to 70 degrees: the opening reads as a printed spread, the end sits low at the desk with the paper walls facing camera in three layers
Standing pieces reveal die-cut recesses, root shadows narrow with the angle, hinge occlusion and a one-time light pass mid-rise; 156f total
